text: On the pilot's thoughts and gaps on CA004: "- Q4 nope the commander knows what he asks for. not needed. - `conduct` -  redundant question I already chose `output` in a roster. - Workshop the dispatch records move. - \"how much output\" - I think dispatch record should be pilots alone (any ID based document actually), anything bulk from crews in notepad. cockpit based hook output could be new \"events/\" directory in records. happy with the rest of your leanings and your next steps. this session is fairly big so needs a new log on soon, probably starting with the next team run."
